normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field only when that exact suffix is present.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation, name tokens and authorship tokens.
matching.accepted: Exactly one WFO 2026-06 accepted species has the exact normalized scientific name, authorship and species rank.
matching.redirect: Exactly one WFO 2026-06 synonym name has the exact normalized scientific name, authorship and species rank and explicitly points to one accepted WFO species.
matching.ambiguous: Exact WFO records resolve to more than one accepted WFO species.
matching.unmatched: No exact WFO species-name record exists.
matching.withheld: The COL authorship boundary cannot be removed exactly or a required WFO accepted target is absent.
matching.upstreamOnly: A WFO 2026-06 accepted species is not the unambiguous target of any COL26.8 plant record.
matching.forbidden: No fuzzy, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, punctuation-stripped, edit-distance, phonetic, token-reordered, genus-substitution or authority-only matching is permitted.

evidenceBoundary: Exact release-pinned nomenclatural linkage only; no fuzzy matching, concept equivalence, phylogeny, ecology, fossil, media, translation, dossier or expert-review claim.
